architecture: one-way age satellite; no macroeconomic feedback from age employment
stock_units: 100 = potential labour force of this age band in 2026; NOT headcounts
flow_units: annual % of potential labour force of this age band in 2026
interval: 5th/95th percentiles of assumed parameter draws, NOT statistical confidence intervals

calibration_sources.all_age_numbers: EME/LIC age profiles and all matching/turnover/AI coefficients remain assumptions. ADV structure and participation use observed EU aggregates; within five-year groups ages are uniform.
calibration_sources.ADV_age_profile: Eurostat lfsa_pganws, EU27_2020, 2025, sex T, citizen TOTAL; five-year groups aggregated without averaging rates. Initial unemployment SHAPE is normalized to original ADV u_star. EU is a proxy, not all advanced economies.
calibration_sources.hire_hazard_scale: Consistency calibration (calibrate_consistency.py): per-region factor on first-hire and rehire hazards so that the no-AI reference world, central parameters, has mean active unemployment equal to the macro structural rate u* over 2027-2046. Not an empirical estimate.
